# `aitbc monitor campaign-stats`

Show statistics for a monitoring campaign.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc monitor campaign-stats [CAMPAIGN_ID]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `campaign_id` | text | no | — |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc monitor campaign-stats
```
